headline: Malaysia's communications regulator says it has received a complaint about AI-generated sexual images and videos allegedly showing students and teachers at a school in Kedah.
score_reason: Kept at the pool score: official regulator action on AI-made abuse content involving children, new on 8 Oct 2026.
importance_line: Students and teachers named in such content face serious harm, and creators or sharers face fines and jail, but the complaint is only being investigated and no findings have been announced.
summary: Bernama reports, in a story carried by The Star, that the Malaysian Communications and Multimedia Commission said on 8 Oct 2026 it has received a complaint over AI-made sexual images and videos allegedly of students and teachers at a school in Kedah, and will cooperate with other agencies in the investigation. It reminded the public that creating or sharing such content is an offence carrying a fine of up to RM500,000 or up to two years in prison, with up to five years where children are involved.
notes: Bernama is the original wire service; The Star published the story.
